title: Delivery

posts.caption:
Delivery, plainly.
Rs. 200 for one pair. Free on two pairs or more.
Dispatch within 24 hours of confirmation; orders confirmed on a Sunday or holiday go out the next working day.
2 to 6 working days across Pakistan. Cash on Delivery.
#DAURSupply #CashOnDelivery #Pakistan
